blocks.heading: How Creators Actually Make Money in India

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: YouTube AdSense, Facebook in-stream ads, and similar programs pay based on views and watch time. In India, 1 lakh views typically earns somewhere between ₹1,500 and ₹5,000, with finance, education, and business content usually paying a higher CPM than entertainment.

items.text: GST registration becomes compulsory once your annual turnover crosses roughly ₹20 lakh (roughly ₹10 lakh in a few special-category states), confirm the current figures on gst.gov.in rather than assuming last year's number still holds.

Presumptive taxation under Section 44ADA is available to many creators with gross receipts under ₹50 lakh, treating 50% of receipts as taxable profit and removing the need for a mandatory tax audit below that threshold, worth discussing with a chartered accountant once income becomes regular.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Most active creators earn under ₹18,000 a month, and the median is far lower. Income depends on audience size, niche and how many revenue streams you have. A nano creator might earn nothing to a few thousand rupees from occasional brand posts, while mid-size creators with ads, sponsorships and a product can earn tens of thousands. Treat any figure as an indicative range and do your own maths with the platform table above.

figures.label: Typical Salary Range
figures.source: Far less than the highlight reels suggest. Of an estimated 20-25 lakh active creators in India, only around 8-10% monetize well enough for it to count as a real income, and a widely cited Kofluence survey found close to 90% of digital creators cannot rely on social platforms as a full-time income source.

blocks.heading: Brand Deals and Building a Media Kit

items.text: Quote a package, not just a post.
Anchor on engagement rate, not just follower count.
Price the deal on what it's worth to the brand, not on your own cost or effort.
Ask for usage rights and exclusivity separately.
Get terms in writing before you post.

blocks.heading: Mistakes That Keep Creator Income Stuck

items.text: Chasing follower count instead of a defined niche.
Waiting for ad revenue to become the main income.
No owned audience outside the platform.
Underpricing brand deals and products out of fear of losing the deal.
Treating a good month as the new normal.
